## Save/Load 2 – Stage 3 full stage output

```{r}
#| label: params-save-load_Stage3_2
#| code-summary: "Parameters - Save or load the complete Stage 3 object set"


stage3_2_rds_path <- "C:/Users/ascsh/Documents/1_Artemis/11_PaqLab/115_TreeTimeAlign/SaveLoad/Stage3_2_BOS_F1_P1_4mS2_15mS1.rds"



stage3_2_save <- TRUE

.par_apply("params-save-load_Stage3_2")
```

```{r}
#| label: save-load_Stage3_2
#| code-summary: "Save or load the complete Stage 3 object set"

# A batch decides these itself, whatever they are left set to above. Both are
# read a few lines below, in this same chunk, so the driver's overrides land
# too late to reach them - and a stage left switched to LOAD after an
# interactive session would otherwise make a batch write no checkpoint at all
# and say nothing about it. Saving is what a batch is for; loading is a no-op
# in one, since every stage runs in the same session.
if (.in_batch()) { stage3_2_save <- TRUE; stage3_2_load <- FALSE }

# ── Manifest = Stage 3.1's set + everything Steps 3.12-3.17 create ─────────────
# Built ON TOP of .stage3_1_required / .stage3_1_optional (still in scope from
# the Stage 3.1 chunk) rather than retyped, so this checkpoint is a strict
# superset of the previous one. Consequence, by design: loading Stage 2 (or
# Stage 3.1) puts the earlier objects in memory, then running Steps 3.12-3.17
# adds the rest, and THIS save succeeds without re-running the Stage 3.1 save
# chunk. The old hand-listed Stage-1/2 names (s5_slice_bot, fp_s5,
# ellipses_ax_1, the vcircle IRLS weights, ...) were renamed or retired in
# Stage 3.1 and are intentionally NOT named here; they arrive via inheritance
# under their current names.
# Only the SAVE branch needs this. A LOAD reads the manifest out of the file
# itself, so it must not be blocked by a manifest the session cannot build -
# that requirement is exactly what made resuming from this checkpoint in a fresh
# session impossible.
if (stage3_2_save && !exists(".stage3_1_required"))
  stop("Stage 3.2 SAVE inherits from .stage3_1_required, which is not defined - run the Stage 3.1 chunk first. (Loading needs none of this.)")

# Per-signal object names are generated from the registry, so all 13 signals'
# tables travel without a 65-line hand list and the manifest never goes stale
# when the registry changes.
.sig_keys <- if (exists("s5_signal_registry")) names(s5_signal_registry) else character(0)
.stage3_1_required <- if (exists(".stage3_1_required")) .stage3_1_required else character(0)
.stage3_1_optional <- if (exists(".stage3_1_optional")) .stage3_1_optional else character(0)
.per_signal <- c(
  paste0("peaks_1_",       .sig_keys),   # 3.12 extrema, epoch 1
  paste0("peaks_2_",       .sig_keys),   # 3.12 extrema, epoch 2
  paste0("pm_candidates_", .sig_keys),   # 3.13 candidates (carry agg_score from 3.14)
  paste0("pm_pair_shift_", .sig_keys),   # 3.14 per-pair-signal shift
  paste0("s57_results_",   .sig_keys)    # 3.14 compatibility per-pair table
)

.stage3_2_new_required <- c(
  # -- Step 3.12 peak/trough identification ------------------------
  "s3_pk_edge_m", "s3_pk_maj_frac", "s3_pk_min_dist_m", "s3_pk_ripple_frac",
  # -- Step 3.13 candidate scoring ---------------------------------
  "s5_pm_score_params", "s57_run_flags", "s57_candidates_all",
  # -- Step 3.14 candidate weighting -> per-pair-signal shift ------
  "s5_pm_shift_method", "s5_pm_factors", "s5_pm_weights",
  # -- Step 3.14b sector pooling -----------------------------------
  "s3_pool_sectors", "s3_pool_pattern", "s3_pool_name", "s3_pool_mad_k",
  "s3_pool_min_sectors", "s3_pool_applied",
  "s57_results", "s57_pair_shift",
  # -- Step 3.15 two-stage MAD -> per-pair Z-shift -----------------
  "s58_use_request", "s58_pair_k", "s58_group_k", "s58_group_k_default",
  "s58_signal_weight", "s58_signal_weight_default",
  "long", "s58_pair_shift", "s58_pair_signals", "s58_pair_tbl", "s58_pair_pool",
  # -- Step 3.16 final mean across pairs ---------------------------
  "s58_final_method",
  # -- Step 3.17 recorded Z-translation ----------------------------
  "apply_mode_3_18", "custom_z_shift_m", "t_trans_z",
  # -- Per-signal tables (generated from the registry) -------------
  .per_signal
)

.stage3_2_new_optional <- c(
  # -- Step 3.13.3 truth / recommended weights (only if that chunk ran) --
  "s5_pm_true_shift", "s5_pm_recommended_weights",
  # -- Step 3.14b / 3.14 rf (only when those paths ran) ------------
  "s3_pool_tbl", "pm_pair_shift_protrusion", "s57_results_protrusion",
  "s5_rf_model_path", "s5_rf_delta_m", "s5_rf_k", "s5_rf_model_used",
  # -- Step 3.16 alternative final estimates -----------------------
  "s58_final_plain", "s58_final_nweight", "s58_final_median"
)

# Inherit Stage 3.1's manifest, then add Stage 3.2's own objects.
.stage3_2_required <- unique(c(.stage3_1_required, .stage3_2_new_required))
.stage3_2_optional <- setdiff(unique(c(.stage3_1_optional, .stage3_2_new_optional)),
                              .stage3_2_required)

if (stage3_2_save) {
  .stage_save(stage3_2_rds_path, .stage3_2_required, .stage3_2_optional, label = "Stage 3.2")
}

if (stage3_2_load) {
  .stage_load(stage3_2_rds_path, .stage3_2_required, .stage3_2_optional, label = "Stage 3.2")
  cat(sprintf("\nStage 3 restored: %d pair(s) | recorded Z-shift %.4f m (not yet applied)\n",
              nrow(pairs_stage3), t_trans_z))
  .report_pivot1()
}
```

Next step

Run `Stage4_ApplyZShift.qmd`. It loads this checkpoint (no point clouds) and
applies `t_trans_z` to the ellipse centres and to `pivot1`, producing `pivot2`.
